about: Coordinates measured from Yan Flash P2 diagrams for drawing. Same units as p1.json (arena radius 1, +x east, +y north). Every number is read from an image (never invented) and needs owner approval per scene.

measurement.base: Same 2000x2000 arena as P1: centre (1000,1000) px, radius 975 px; checked on yan-p2-07 (waymark A at 0.727 north, D at 0.722 west).

methods.auto: Yan's cyan player dot detected by colour (scripts/measure_dots.py), or a role icon (scripts/measure_yan.py).
methods.eye: Read by eye from a 1000 px view (±0.01).

measurement.sizes: Tower, stack, circle and bait radii read by eye from the drawn circles' edges (±0.01).

waymarks.note: Same values in all three images (±0.006).

p2-forsaken/raidwide.note: Yan only says west/east of the boss; no spots are drawn.

shapes.label: Forsaken: very heavy raidwide

p2-forsaken/odd-towers-1.note: Example deal for tower 1: MT+H1 and D1+D3 got the stacks (H1, D3), the supports got cones and the DPS circles; who gets what is random. Drawn relative to the towers: the towers count as south wherever they spawn (they move 45° each set), so no waymarks are shown.

H1.note: Left stack (support stack holder, top spot).

MT.note: Cone holder, bottom of the left tower.

H2.note: Outside pair: baits the cone just below the left tower.

OT.note: Outside pair: left tower's north-east edge on the boss ring; shares the left stack.

D3.note: Right stack (DPS stack holder, top spot).

D1.note: Circle holder, bottom of the right tower.

D2.note: Outside pair: right tower's north-west edge; shares the right stack. Yan draws one dot for both outside DPS (marii and Kitten put both here).

D4.note: Same spot as D2 (one dot in Yan's picture).
